name: CtxDock
summary: Local, selective project memory for coding agents. Save decisions, fixes, constraints, and handoffs, then retrieve only relevant context across sessions.
requires: Agent with terminal and local filesystem access
compatibility_note: Requires Python 3.11+ with SQLite FTS5 and an agent permitted to run shell commands and write local user storage. Codex is verified. Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and VS Code Copilot support remains experimental.
